description: Import a game from another launcher as a separate copy.
noCandidates: No supported games found. Choose a game or instance folder.
unsupportedImport: This game cannot be imported yet.
dataDirectoryHint: Choose which mods, settings, and other game files to copy.
noDataDirectory: No importable game data folder was found.
automaticHint: Choose a responsive source automatically and switch if it fails.
installLocationHint: A separate game folder will be created here.
copyNotice: Close the source game first. Mods, settings, resource packs, and shaders will be copied; the source folder stays unchanged.
movedRoots: Moved {count} independent content folders from the source.
retainedRoots: Some content folders remain in the source ({count}).
sharedRuntimeRetained: Shared assets and libraries remain in the source folder.
desktopOnly: Import existing games in the desktop app.
readLocationError: Could not read the install location: {cause}
readSourceError: Could not read the source game: {cause}
invalidDownloadSource: The download source settings are invalid.
invalidMirror: Enter an HTTPS mirror URL without credentials, query parameters, or a fragment.
nameTooLong: Game names must be 80 characters or fewer.
moveNotice: Close the source game first. After migration, the selected source content moves to the Recycle Bin. Shared resources and loose settings files stay in place.
